import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam

def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    
    mgr = adsk.cam.CAMManager.get()
    libMgr = mgr.libraryManager
    toolLibs = libMgr.toolLibraries
    
    localRoot = toolLibs.urlByLocation(adsk.cam.LibraryLocations.LocalLibraryLocation)
    
    # Open the TIW library
    tiwURL = None
    for u in toolLibs.childAssetURLs(localRoot):
        if 'TIW' in u.toString():
            tiwURL = u
            break
    
    print('TIW URL:', tiwURL.toString())
    tiwLib = toolLibs.toolLibraryAtURL(tiwURL)
    print('Tool count:', tiwLib.count)
    
    # List all tools
    for i in range(tiwLib.count):
        tool = tiwLib.item(i)
        params = tool.parameters
        # Get key parameters
        try:
            dc = params.itemByName('dc')  # cutting diameter
            dc_val = dc.value.value if dc else None
        except:
            dc_val = None
        try:
            desc_param = params.itemByName('description')
            desc = desc_param.value.value if desc_param else ''
        except:
            desc = ''
        try:
            tooltip_param = params.itemByName('tool_comment')
            tooltip = tooltip_param.value.value if tooltip_param else ''
        except:
            tooltip = ''
        
        print(f'Tool {i:3d}: DC={dc_val}  desc={desc!r}  comment={tooltip!r}')

    rough_inp = setup.operations.createInput('adaptive2d')
    rough_inp.tool = tiw_tool
    rough_op = setup.operations.add(rough_inp)
    rough_op.name = 'Pocket_Rough_Adaptive2D'
    
    print('Roughing op created:', rough_op.name)
    print('Tool on op:', rough_op.tool.parameters.itemByName('tool_description').value.value)
    
    # ── Set geometry: pocket floor face ───────────────────────────────
    # Face 5 = pocket floor, Z=3.0cm, normal=-Z (area=35.7854 cm2)
    pocket_floor = None
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        face = body.faces.item(i)
        surf = face.geometry
        bb = face.boundingBox
        # Pocket floor: Plane, Z=3.0cm, normal -Z
        if hasattr(surf, 'normal'):
            n = surf.normal
            if (abs(n.z - (-1.0)) < 0.01 and  # normal points -Z
                abs(bb.minPoint.z - 3.0) < 0.01 and
                abs(bb.maxPoint.z - 3.0) < 0.01):
                pocket_floor = face
                print(f'Found pocket floor: face {i}, area={face.area:.4f}cm2')
                break

        raise RuntimeError('Could not find pocket floor face!')
    
    # Assign the pocket geometry 
    p = rough_op.parameters.itemByName('pockets')
    cv = adsk.cam.CadContours2dParameterValue.cast(p.value)
    css = cv.getCurveSelections()
    css.clear()

    wall_inp = setup.operations.createInput('contour2d')
    wall_inp.tool = tiw_tool
    wall_op = setup.operations.add(wall_inp)
    wall_op.name = 'Pocket_Wall_Finish_Contour2D'
    print('Wall finishing op created:', wall_op.name)
    
    # Find pocket floor face for geometry selection
    pocket_floor = None
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        face = body.faces.item(i)
        surf = face.geometry
        bb = face.boundingBox
        if hasattr(surf, 'normal'):
            n = surf.normal
            if (abs(n.z - (-1.0)) < 0.01 and
                abs(bb.minPoint.z - 3.0) < 0.01 and
                abs(bb.maxPoint.z - 3.0) < 0.01):
                pocket_floor = face
                break
    
    if pocket_floor is None:
        raise RuntimeError('Pocket floor not found')
    
    # Assign contour geometry: use the pocket floor as a face contour selection
    # This drives the tool along the WALL perimeter at pocket floor level
    p = wall_op.parameters.itemByName('contours')
    if p is None:
        # Try 'pockets'
        p = wall_op.parameters.itemByName('pockets')
        print('Using pockets param for contour op')
    else:
        print('Using contours param')
    
    cv = adsk.cam.CadContours2dParameterValue.cast(p.value)
    css = cv.getCurveSelections()
    css.clear()

    sel = css.createNewFaceContourSelection()
    sel.inputGeometry = [pocket_floor]

    wp.itemByName('tool_feedRamp').value.value     = 45.72  # 457.2 mm/min

    if p_vstl:
        p_vstl.value.value = 0.0

    if p_md:
        # For wall finishing - do full depth in one pass
